subject: general
question: Ananya, Jaya, Priya, Roma, Geeta and Deepa were having a picnic lunch around a circular table. They were facing the table's centre. Exactly two people sit between Roma and Priya. Roma sits second to the right of Ananya. Deepa was second to the left of Jaya. Who was to the immediate left of Deepa?
solution:
As given,

Ananya, Jaya, Priya, Roma, Geeta and Deepa are seating around a circular table facing the centre,

then, as per the conditions given in the question,

1) Exactly two people sit between Roma and Priya

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51c309071192fca4f6557af8712477d703b8a9e413b47892d1164d75ea337553.png] 

2) Roma sits second to the right of Ananya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b62e310adce5bc0caa2023138432596db5ba6949b41c74d54022af90b3dc099.png] 

3) Deepa was second to the left of Jaya.

This is only possible when Jaya is to the immediate right of Roma and Jaya is to the immediate left of the Roma.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d3a768eb249fba595dd8914a153ec6b2ed8f4170d98d4b988d63a088fa992ec.png] 

4) The only person left Geeta will take the only vacant place, thus

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d3a768eb249fba595dd8914a153ec6b2ed8f4170d98d4b988d63a088fa992ec.png] 

Therefore, Ananya is to the immediate left of Deepa.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Ananya"**.
